title: First Order Energy
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state that E^(1) = 0 due to parity considerations.

title: Second Order Energy
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for E^(2) involving the summation over states.

title: Perturbation Theory Application
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of applying perturbation theory to the problem.

title: Parity Consideration
description: Important Criteria: The student must explain the significance of parity in determining the first-order energy correction.

title: Matrix Element Evaluation
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss the evaluation of matrix elements and their contributions to the second-order correction.

title: Sign of Energy Correction
description: Important Criteria: The student should mention that E^(2) is negative and its implications regarding the electric field strength.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid errors related to incorrect assumptions about degeneracy or neglecting terms in the perturbation expansion.

title: Units Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
